title: Separatedness from an affine open cover with affine overlaps and surjective restriction maps
statement: Let $S$ be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme], $f:V\to S$ a morphism of schemes, and $V=\bigcup_{a\in A}V_a$ a covering of $V$ by affine open subschemes. Suppose that for all $a,b\in A$ the open subscheme $V_a\cap V_b$ is affine and the ring map $\mathcal O_V(V_a)\otimes_{\mathbf Z}\mathcal O_V(V_b)\to\mathcal O_V(V_a\cap V_b)$, $x\otimes y\mapsto x|_{V_a\cap V_b}\cdot y|_{V_a\cap V_b}$, is surjective. Then $f$ is separated [def-weil-proper-morphism], i.e. its diagonal $V\to V\times_SV$ [def-pc-fibre-product] is a closed immersion.
